validity.recommendation: Human de-dup pass: reconcile P1897 against P3962 (East–West Gas Pipeline / Main Line) and the sibling segment rows P1900 (UBTG-km56-AY-1 KP916) / P1903 (AY–1 KP943-Riyadh / Pump Station and A47/Yanbu). Decide whether P1897 is a redundant segment label for the same Shedgum/Riyadh–Yanbu gas trunk (delete/merge) or a distinct parallel MGS loop line (keep, but rename to a real designation and set endpoints).
validity.researcher_notes: P1897 'A47-Yanbu gas pipeline' (966 km, dia 42/48/56 in, gas, Saudi Aramco 100%, Yanbu terminus) is the trans-peninsula sales-gas trunk of Aramco's Master Gas System (MGS) / East-West gas corridor. Independent sources establish this corridor as ONE line: Oil & Gas Journal reports Aramco built 'a 1,200 km pipeline' to 'deliver about 300 MMscfd of sales gas from Shedgum to Yanbu' (matches GEM P3962 East-West Gas Pipeline Main Line: 1200 km, Eastern Province->Yanbu, dia 48, gas, Aramco). BlackRidge's MGS-3 profile describes the same 'east-west corridor' with pump stations EWPS-1..EWPS-10 (Shedgum->Riyadh->Yanbu/Rabigh/Jeddah). GulfPub's INDEPENDENT SDE Dec-2025 scrape represents this corridor as single features too: 'East-West Gas Pipeline' (Abqaiq/Shedgum->Yanbu) and 'Master Gas System 2 (MGS 2)' Riyadh->Yanbu, len 924 km — GEM's 966 km is a near-match to that 924 km Riyadh->Yanbu figure, i.e. P1897 is most likely the western (Riyadh->Yanbu) portion of the same trunk that P3962 covers end-to-end. GulfPub carries NO 'A47-Yanbu' feature. Whole GEM cluster P1897-P1912 (all stub rows, batch-dated 2022-07-19, engineering segment-ID names: 'A47', 'AY-1 KP916', 'AY-1 KP943', 'UBTG-1 km0/km56', no endpoints) looks digitized from a segment/GIS layer of the same East-West gas system that P3962 (properly named, dated 2024-08-09) now represents — classic segment double-count. Caveat: the MGS East-West corridor does run parallel/looped lines (EWGP-1..4), so P1897 could conceivably be a distinct loop rather than a pure duplicate; hence flag for human adjudication vs deletion.

validity.recommendation: Do not treat 'A47-Yanbu gas pipeline' as an independently-attested named pipeline. If P1897 survives the de-dup, rename to a real public designation (East-West gas / MGS segment) and cite a source that actually names the physical line; otherwise merge into P3962.
validity.researcher_notes: The name 'A47-Yanbu' is unattested anywhere outside gem.wiki — targeted web search ('A47-Yanbu'/'A47 Yanbu' pipeline, excluding GEM) returns only the gem.wiki page and unrelated East-West CRUDE/NGL pipeline material. 'A47' is not one of the publicly-named MGS East-West pump stations (those are EWPS-1..EWPS-10 per BlackRidge); it reads as an internal engineering/segment label. The gem.wiki row is a stub: no start/end location, no capacity, no start year, no route. Its only two citations are generic and do NOT name this pipeline — an OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin 2012 (p.75, country-level oil/gas stats) and Aramco's corporate 'our history' page. Per project rule, a row whose only support is a generic citation not naming the pipeline is itself an existence flag. No independent confirmation that a discretely-named 'A47-Yanbu' line exists as its own entity (as opposed to a slice of the East-West/MGS gas trunk). SPEC caveat: length 966 km is not independently corroborable — corridor sources give 1,200 km (Shedgum->Yanbu, OGJ) or 924 km (MGS2 Riyadh->Yanbu, GulfPub); diameter 42/48/56 in and capacity (blank) could not be independently confirmed either. Do not silently pass the specs.

routes.corridor_desc: The physical corridor is Aramco's Master Gas System / East-West sales-gas trunk: from the Shedgum/Abqaiq gas complexes in the Eastern Province, west-northwest across the Nejd plateau through the Riyadh central-region cluster, then west over the Hejaz escarpment down to Yanbu al-Bahr on the Red Sea (with laterals onward to Rabigh and Jeddah per BlackRidge). The Yanbu terminus is firmly established. The 'A47' start node is NOT locatable from any public source; because GEM's 966 km closely matches GulfPub's 924 km Riyadh->Yanbu MGS2 segment, the start most plausibly sits in the Riyadh area rather than at the Eastern Province origin, but this is inferred, not sourced. Corridor bound is loose: endpoints (Yanbu firm; Shedgum/Riyadh as candidate east anchors) are defensible, exact alignment and the A47 node are not.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from independent MGS/East-West gas corridor sources: OGJ ('300 MMscfd of sales gas from Shedgum to Yanbu via a 1,200 km pipeline') anchors the Shedgum->Yanbu trunk; BlackRidge MGS-3 details the east-west corridor and Yanbu/Rabigh/Jeddah delivery with EWPS-1..EWPS-10 stations. End coord = Yanbu al-Bahr port city (well-known place, ~24.089N 38.064E). Waypoint coords are approximate from the named cities Riyadh (~24.71N 46.68E) and the Shedgum/Abqaiq area (~26.0N 49.6E) — defensible from named places, NOT surveyed pipe coordinates. Start (A47) lat/lon left null: no source locates 'A47', so no coordinate fabricated. This is a suggestion set for a later human routes-repo branch, not an auto-applied route.

summary: P1897 A47-Yanbu = segment label for the Aramco East-West/MGS sales-gas trunk to Yanbu; concern (duplicate of P3962 + existence: name unattested outside GEM, stub row, generic non-naming refs); route corridor Shedgum/Riyadh->Yanbu proposed (low).
